name: toxiscan
description: YouTube Comment Toxicity Analyzer — run both frontend and backend together

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend-next
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-next"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend-next"
